name: Hookline
summary: Campaign and ad-budget app for an indie record label, with a vinyl spin room and a budget mixer
about: A complete eight-page app for a small record label that runs ads for its releases. Plan campaigns per release and channel, move the quarter's budget between channels on a mixing desk, plan release days on a drag-and-drop calendar and read monthly reports. It ships with sample data for a made-up Lahore label and works in a light and a dark theme.
how: Press Play in the Spin room on Overview: the record spins while the needle runs through daily spend and streams. Drag the needle or use the arrow keys to read any day.
Switch 30D, 60D or 90D to morph the waveform, the KPIs and the channel donut.
Open Campaigns to search, filter by status, sort, page through and click a row for its detail drawer. New campaign opens a form with checks.
On Budget, drag the faders (or use the arrow keys) to move money between channels, try Even split or Weight by results, then Save mix.
Drag a release or campaign to a new day on the Calendar, or press Enter on it for Move to…
Reports has a 3M, 6M and 12M switch and a CSV export. Settings has the label profile, alerts, theme and Reset demo data.
